message: 思いを馳せて、馳せ参じる

name: Lolotte
message: 「Excuse me, Mr. President. Regarding today, would it be alright if I left a little early...?」

name: Synn
message: 「Hmm, I don't really mind. Do you have some business to take care of?」

name: Synn
message: 「Ah, no, I just naturally thought so.」

name: Lolotte
message: 「M-Mr. President, are you an esper!? What a terrifying person!」
I mean, I can't imagine she'd take time off without having something to do.

name: Lolotte
message: 「That being the case, I'm sorry about today.」

name: Lolotte
message: 「It seems you're curious about my business, Mr. President...」
It is Lolotte we're talking about, after all.

name: Lolotte
message: 「I'll tell you in advance, I'm not going to do anything weird, okay!」
Being emphasized to like that just makes me even more curious.
Finishing up activities, I head out to catch the shopping district's flash sale.
My path was blocked by someone's shadow.

name: Synn
message: 「Didn't you get in my way on purpose?」

name: Riesling
message: 「My sincerest apologies, but the young lady is currently carrying out another mission.」
Did she get hooked on playing spy or something?

name: Riesling
message: 「If you allow your mind to be read so easily, you won't be able to endure torture, you know?」
What kind of torture are we talking about.

name: Riesling
message: 「Should the young lady require anything at all, please do not hesitate to ask me, Riesling Tooyama」

name: Synn
message: 「Like, say, 'A Demon appeared, so please save me'?」

name: Riesling
message: 「An easy task. I am sure the young lady would be delighted as well」

name: Riesling
message: 「Now then, I must return to my duties. Please excuse me」
Now, off to the flash sale I go...

name: Synn
message: 「Hey, Amyrina. I'm heading to a flash sale right now--want to come with?」

name: Amyrina
message: 「So this is how humans take in nutrients」
Though strictly speaking, she might not be human.

name: Synn
message: 「I've felt someone watching us for a while now... Do you notice anything, Amyrina?」

name: Lolotte
message: 「Honestly, President, sticking so close to Amyrina like that... you're grinning way too much」
It's the exact same thing Amyrina did before, except their roles are reversed?
Something grazed right past my cheek.
Wait a second, is this a 'say it and I'll hit you' message from Riesling!?

name: Amyrina
message: 「President. Could it be that you like Lolotte?」

name: Amyrina
message: 「Still, I never knew that not being able to talk with someone I care about could hurt this much\s02」

name: Amyrina
message: 「I want to chat with Lolotte again as soon as possible...」

name: Synn
message: 「I hope you two can make up soon」

name: Lolotte
message: 「Amyrina... You want to talk with me that badly...」
